title: Amethyst finder
description: Adds distinct purple highlights to Smooth Basalt, making Amethyst Geodes instantly recognizable.
body:
💎 **Amethyst finder**

Make your search for Amethyst effortless. Adds distinct purple highlights to Smooth Basalt, making geodes instantly recognizable when you're out on a mining run.

**Features:**

Visual Clarity: Adds amethyst picture on a shell of geodes.

Efficient Hunting: Spot geodes at a distance in dark caves or underwater.

Lightweight: Standard 16x textures with zero impact on FPS.

**How it works:**

Since Smooth Basalt naturally forms the outer layer of geodes, this pack turns those dull grey blocks into a clear indicator. It ensures that when you're on the hunt for amethyst you won't accidentally walk right past your target.
